label: EXPERIMENT - AU-510M Auto AGC-T Watcher
info: Separate AU-510M watcher. Auto defaults OFF; tab exported disabled. All nine states implemented. Exact API: slice s <slice> agc_threshold=<integer 0..100>, documented by FlexRadio https://github.com/flexradio/smartsdr-api-docs/wiki/TCPIP-slice#SET and transported by installed flexradio-request / flexradio-radio / flexradio-js. Status field agc_threshold. Actual hardware success requires zero response and matching live threshold status after each command. No power/mode/antenna/transmit/tuning command permitted. Scan only at a user-configured quiet frequency, selected active slice dynamically. No invented quiet frequencies. UI /agct-watcher offers per-band quiet MHz, use-current, clear, and optional scan start; persistent settings saved atomically at /mnt/dietpi_userdata/node-red/agct-watcher-settings.json. Use-current saves only a frequency; does not retune or certify quietness. Manual tune to the configured frequency before calibration in this version. Baseline 4 seconds; downward steps of 2, settle 2.5 seconds, 4-second windows, >=20 live dBm samples of both meters. Reject >2 dB spread or >1 dB input drift. Require observed plateau, >=1.5 dB AGC+ fall and a second independent confirmation window. Knee offset +1, then one confirmed final apply and DONE. RX loss, changed slice/receive settings, stale data, failed commands or timeouts abort with no restoration/write on TX. OFF immediately revokes permits; last applied threshold remains on abort. Read requests only from subscription whitelist; write gate accepts only matching, expiring, single-use core permits. No dashboard backend changes. Live calibration not yet validated. Deploy/update explicitly: node /mnt/dietpi_userdata/node-red/scripts/deploy-agct-watcher.mjs --deploy . Simplified UI: adopt measurement QRG, then one-shot Start from AGC-T 100; RX/meter checks are automatic. One-shot temporarily enables writes and restores prior Auto state after DONE or abort. No radio tuning command: adopt only saves the QRG. Auto band-change mode is separate under advanced settings.
